batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b P Negi

batting.name: OA Shah
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b UT Yadav

batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b P Negi

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c KP Pietersen b P Negi

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c R Dravid b GB Hogg

batting.name: KP Pietersen
batting.dismissal: c OA Shah b SR Watson

batting.name: LRPL Taylor
batting.dismissal: c SP Goswami b GB Hogg

balls.text: on the pads, through to the keeper for a single, and Rajasthan end on 141, not often that a team scores more in the first 10 than in the second half
once more work to do for Pietersen as the ball is thumped to the left of long-on, can't prevent the second this time
short of length and outside leg stump, swung towards deep midwicket for one more
a flat-batted hit towards long-off, Pietersen is onto that quickly, keeping the batsmen to a single
length ball on off stump, hit powerfully towards midwicket for a single
starts with a full ball outside off, carved towards deep backward point for a single
short of length ball over the stumps, looks to slash that but is beaten, another good day at the office for Morkel
a full delivery in the blockhole, following the batsman, squeezed towards point
shortish and on leg stump, batsman sways to get behind that and guide it towards backward point
gets it away this time, overpitched on the pads, thrashes this towards midwicket for four
short of length ball, on middle stump, batsman backs away and plays it towards point

Morkel outstanding IPL continues, the 19th over changed the game two days ago, this time he starts the 19th with the wicket of Dravid, a back of length ball that Dravid wanted to club but ended up inside-eding onto his pad and then the stumps
look to swipe this length one, the ball was angling across and Goswami is beaten, good over that from Umesh
slashed towards cover by Dravid
wide outside off, Dravid carves it towards wide long-off, the ball was in the air for a long time, Jaywardene has to race across from long-off to stop that from reaching the rope
backs away from leg and looks to thump that through the off side, doesn't connect and the ball goes through to the keeper
short of length and just outside off, dropped towards backward point for a single
short of length and a it of width, 134kph, slapped towards sweeper cover by Dravid
length ball is pushed towards extra cover for a single
a low full toos by Morkel, 147.1 kph, pushed towards mid-on for a single
not timed that one, lobs to the left of the bowler for a single
stabs this back of length ball towards backward point
full ball is driven powerfully by Dravid, an inside-out hit as gets plenty of pace on it to beat a diving Pietersen at mid-off, that brings up his 50 as well
pitched up by Morkel, he jumps up in appeal, asking for the lbw, might have pitched outside leg that out as Goswami was struck in front
length ball is driven towards cover for one more
blocked to the right of the bowler, Goswami wants one but Dravid doesn't
defended towards square leg, Sehwag targetting the pads here
length ball on the pads, Dravid rocks back and thumps that towards midwicket, where what was a regulation stop is mucked up by Irfan Pathan, concedes the boundary
at last a boundary for Rajasthan, like most in this innings it is a conventional hit, skipping down the track and driving it towards extra cover
full delivery is driven along the ground towards long-on for one more
crunched towards mid-on for a quick single, the spinners getting through their overs quickly here
heaved towards deep midwicket for one more
down the leg side, looks to power it to the leg side, ends up sending it towards short fine leg
defended from the crease towards mid-on
way down the leg side, keeper has some work to do to collect that
length ball is worked off the back foot towards mid-on
fuller and on middle and leg, Dravid gets on the back foot and clips it towards square leg
gets forward and drives this towards long-on, a quiet over so far this
floated wide outside off, pushed towards cover off the front foot
length ball pitching on leg stump, worked just behind square leg, Sehwag is bowling round the wicket here
punched towards long-off for a single
Sehwag bowls, his first ball is defended

Negi gets four, 4 for 18 for Negi, easily the best bowling figures for the 19-year-old, Menaria was looking to power that off the back foot, a bit of a top edge on that and the ball balloons towards Pietersen at long-on, easy take for him and Rajasthan have slumped from 87 for 1 to 95 for 5, that was the last ball of Negi's spell as well, not a bad way to finish
fired in quicker, and wider, Menaria looks to chop that towards backward point but misses out
length ball outside off, punched towards sweeper cover for a couple

Negi's dream day continues, Hodge is the man to go, and this is turning into an alarming collapse for Rajasthan, looking to smash that from outside off, off the back foot, couldn't keep it low and that flies to backward point, and what seemed a formidable middle order of Shah, Watson and Hodge has folded in the space of ten deliveries
backs away again and pushes this towards extra cover
a bit of width again from Umesh, Dravid slaps this slower one, 112kph, towards sweeper cover for a single
short of length ball angling in towards off stump, defended to the left of the bowler for a single, plenty of bounce for Umesh here

Rajasthan are three down, and rapidly losing their way, Shah is the man who's gone this time, looking for a cute shot over short fine leg,doesn't get enough on it, off the glove I think, and the ball lobs towards the keeper, easy as they come for the keeper
shortish and well outside off, slapped towards sweeper cover by Dravid, who backed away a touch to make room
short of length and heading towards the thigh pad, 134 kph from Umesh,helped behind square leg
whipped towards midwicket by Dravid
punches his first ball back towards the bowler

huge wicket this, Watto is gone as he looks to swipe that towards his favourite midwicket region, that stayed lower than Watson expected and sneaked under his bat, off stump is on the ground, Negi is jumping for joy
full ball that Watson looks to thump down the ground, mistimed to the right of the bowler
spins away after pitching short of a length, pushed towards cover for a single
sweeps this towards fine leg for two more
shuffles away from the stumps, and stabs this in front of point for four, just a bit of width, and that's enough for Dravid, this outfield is pretty quick as well
or not, Watson makes his first mow and it's a successful one, he loves that deep midwicket region and his pull goes high and far over the boundary
cut off the back foot to point
Watson pushes tentatively on the front foot and plays to extra cover
Dravid skips outside leg to make room and drive inside out through extra cover
cut off the back foot from close to off stump through point
defended on the back foot on the leg side
tossed up outside off, Watson drives on the front foot to long off
tries to drive on the front foot but gets an inside edge on to the pad
the reverse sweep goes wrong, what a way for such a good partnership to end. He hits it from outside leg stump to Sehwag at point, easy catch
played off the back foot to point
driven off the back foot towards the bowler's left, the bowler dives to save runs
goes back, makes room and drives the ball hard to the fielder on the cover boundary
driven with power towards long off
he goes back this time to a fuller and quicker ball and gets an inside edge on to the pad
Dravid makes room by moving towards leg and lofts the ball inside out over cover, one-bounce four
another flat and straight ball, driven to long on
the quicker ball on off stump, Dravid cuts the ball from off stump towards third man
chipped down to long-on for a single
whipped towards square leg for a single
safe, Rahane has a slice of luck, he swipes that one from outside off, the ball goes high up, swirls around but lands before Irfan can run in from long-on
punched towards cover off the back foot
Negi flies to his right this time, getting his fingertips on a powerful drive, can't latch on but can't call that a drop
looks to sweep but that is well down the leg side
length ball is pushed off the backfoot, just to the left of a diving bowler

Morkel has struck Rahane there, a 144kph bouncer that Rahane decided to pull, top-edged onto the helmet, the ball loops towards third man for a single, Rahane doesn't seem hurt, they take a look at his helmet though
short of length and outside off, Rahane pokes it towards backward point, can't beat the fielder
played off the backfoot towards point, that was slower from Morkel, 128kph
looks to cut that shortish ball which is just outside off, not too much width, and bounces more than Rahane expects, beaten
short of length and well outside off, 145.9kph, Rahane stays in the crease and lashes that through cover for four more, Rahane flying along here
pushed in front of point for a single

just about clears mid-on, Rahane looks to launch a length ball, he clears the fielder but would have been happier get a bit more on that, Nadeem ponders what might have been, the Rajasthan fifty comes up
more orthodox from Dravid, pushing it along the ground towards long-off for a single
drops it too short, Dravid spots that early, rocks back and clubs that wide of mid-on for four
went in this one after pitching outside off, driving towards mid-off for a single
another single, towards cover this time
Nadeem, Delhi's unlikely bowling hero of the season, to bowl, first ball is pushed towards mid-off for a single
another bouncer to end the over, well outside off this time, Dravid wants nothing to do with that one
another bouncer, just outside off, Rahane isn't too comfortable as he deals with that, chops it towards point for a single
the yorker this time, 147.7kph, squeezed out of the blockhole by rahane
Morkel slips in the bouncer to try unsettle Rahane, who coolly guides that towards third man for a couple
length ball on middle is worked towards mid-on for a single
defended to the off side by Dravid
another easy-on-the-eye drive from Rahane to end the over, in-the-up again and through cover for four more, who needs to slog and swipe to score at T20 pace?
off the pads, and towards point for a leg bye
full and well outside off, not the greatest delivery, punched off the front foot past cover for four, if they keep up this pace, questions on Watson opening will die down
pushed off the back foot towards midwicket for a single
lovely from Rahane, much more of the shot-making that is earning him loads of headlines, an on the up drive along the ground past extra cover for four
not the usual classy shot from Rahane, flatbats a shortish ball over mid-on for four, the bat turns a bit as he plays that, clears mid-on
length ball angling in towards the pads, easy for Dravid to whip that towards the midwicket boundary for four
punches this full delivery towards mid-on
short of length again, close to off stump, steered down towards third man for a single
defended off the back foot towards point
short of length ball providing some width, Rahane pounced on that, no attempt to power that one as he plays a cut sending the ball racing past point
this wasn't very good from Umesh, well down the leg side
no loosener for Umesh, starts with a full 146.6kph delivery, heading for the pads, worked towards square leg
short of length ball outside off, crunched towards extra cover, can't beat the field
angles it wide of off stump this time, pitching well outside off, Rahane chases it and drives towards cover
short of a length and that sat up for Rahane, who swung around to lift that towards deep backward square leg, not too much power on it, more of using the pace, nearly carries all the way
on the pads this time, defended towards square leg

extra bounce there for Irfan Pathan, Dravid is surprised by that one, looking at the surface after he fended that in an ungainly manner, it reared from a short of a length, Dravid managed to poke it towards backward point
defends the first ball towards backward point
Rajasthan's fortress? they have been hammered at the Sawai Man Singh stadium today, it ends with a six over long-off completes, Delhi show why they are the top of the table with a crushing victory
length ball well outside off, carved behind point for four more, Delhi close in on a dominant victory
nudged towards midwicket this time, seemed like it would be a leisurely single, instead the batsmen push for two, well run that
worked to square leg for one more

Sehwag is gone, he has holed out to backward point, he wanted to carve that over the off side, an ambitious shot against the wiles of Hogg, but in this mood Sehwag can pull off anything, this time though he can't get it past Dravid at backward point
Sehwag doesn't move his feet at al as he look to play that one that spins towards the stumps from outside leg, pushed to the off side for a single, there's an overthrow and Sehwag is back on strike
turns it towards backward square leg for a single
more careful defence from Nagar, gets forward and keeps bat and pad together
on the pads, tucked towards midwicket for a single
full and outside off, defended towards cover
length ball outside off, watchfully left alone
lofted towards long-on for a single
defends this short of length ball that is angling in
full and outside off, and another exhibition of the tremendous touch Sehwag is in, the timing and placement are exceptional as he drives it past sweeper cover, the lightning outfield helped as well
clipped to midwicket for one more
guided towards short fine for one more to give Sehwag the strike
'cathc it,' is the call as Sehwag mishits it towards mid-off, lands safe
drilled down the ground, there's no stopping Sehwag in this mood, he dances down and thumps it along the ground, its past the bowler at tremendous speed, long-on had no chance
off the pads towards short fine leg
Nagar gets going with a chop towards deep point, races through for one in the hope of pinching a second, the pressure tells on the fielder who misfield and lets it through for a boundary
looks to cut that one outside off and is beaten, loud appeal for caught behind, umpire Taufel isn't interested
Sehwag just makes a hint of room, and slaps that past backward point for four more, a very controlled hit that
Hogg removes Taylor, that one spins away from him, Taylor goes for the muscular sweep, top-edges that and it doesn't go too far, goes high and results in a simple catch for the keeper
a lofted drive towards long-on, a safe shot for a single
backs away and carves it towards backward point
spins in towards middle and leg after pitching well outside leg, defended from the crease in front of point
way down the leg side, a free run there
slanting in towards middle stump, defended from the crease by Ross Taylor
crunched towards long-off for one more
worked towards square leg for a single, over to Sehwag
fortunate to get a boundary there, a short ball on the leg stump, was that off the handle of the bat, in any case, it runs away past the keeper and is too fine for fine leg
Watson has struck, seems to be too late for Rajasthan, pitched up by Watson, KP looks to smash that over long-off, he can't and he's gone for 36, that's the end of his IPL
short of length ball on middle, defended to the off side by KP
short and spinning away, Sehwag skipped beyond leg and carved that towards sweeper cover
flatter and quicker, wide outside off, chopped towards deep point
pitched up, on middle stump, struck towards midwicket for a couple
outside leg once more, tucked towards square leg for a quick couple
outside leg stump again, KP gets the front leg out of the way and looks to hammer that over midwicket, can't connect and is struck on the thigh pad
on the leg stump, Sehwag doesn't bother to move his feet, clips it behind square leg for a single
short of length ball, for a change it wasn't heading for the pads, on off stump, turned towards wide mid-on
KP makes room, again Chavan follows him, worked towards square leg for a single
into the pads, defended
Sehwag wanted to whip that through the leg side but is beaten, once again he is lucky that also misses the leg stump, keeper can't collect it
looks to hoick this over the leg side, not timed too well, the ball rolls towards long-on
length ball following KP, defended to the off side
short ball outside off, Sehwag looks to crash that one as well but is beaten

fifty no.5 in a row for Sehwag, that's a new record in T20 cricket, no one has done that before, and what a sensational shot to get there, a short ball and Sehwag deftly uppercuts it for his first six of the innings, there were few shots this innings where he put in lesser effort, he's pleased with that knock, has a big grin on his face
this time he gets a quick run, defended towards cover and zips through
short of length ball around off stump, KP defends from the crease towards the bowler, he wants one but realises there isn't one
defended towards point this time by KP
four more, Delhi in a tearing hurry here, when is KP's flight to England? stands tall and whack it on the up past extra cover, KP had no intention of getiting anywhere close to the pitch of that one
a muscular hit towards Chavan at long-on, another tough one for him, he moves across to block it off, doesn't collect it cleanly but he doesn't give away any extra runs
gets the front leg out of the way and looks to whip a quicker one to the leg side, doesn't get hold of it
the worng 'un is chopped off the back foot towards deep  backward point for two more
KP has had enough of watching Sehwag belting it around, KP gets forward and launches that towards midwicket for a six
KP punches it towards point and races through for two

Sehwag doesn't even respect his elders, looks to smash the first ball, powerful hit lands just short of long-on, Dravid thought the fielder there should have done better, it was Chavan who didn't move quickly enough towards the ball, perhaps sighted it late
length ball on off stump, crisply driven towards mid-off by KP, Delhi finish the powerplay on 61/1, Rajasthan hadn't done too badly in theirs either, 56/0 after six they had been
KP joins the fun now, shortish ball from Watson, KP gets on the front foot and pulls that powerfully towards midwicket for four more
length ball outside off, KP raises the bat over his head and lets the ball through to the keeper, take a photo of that, doesn't happen too often in T20s
Sehwag is handcuffed by that line, angling into the pads, can't get bat on that, off the pad and in the direction of slip
four more for Sehwag, not the power hits that have fetched him most of his runs today, this was a delicate whip off the pads for a boundary behind square leg
Pietersen once again is happy to take the single, pushes the ball to mid-off, and its over to Sehwag

four more for Sehwag, that I should just keep that phrase copied, would save me some work, this time over mid-off, timing is off once more but has enough to clear the man in the ring, Rajasthan need wickets fast
two more to Sehwag, a diving Hogg managed to get a hand on that stroke towards midwicket, the fielder in the deep cuts it off but not before KP sprints back for two

unlucky for Amith Singh, four more runs for Delhi, a slower ball heading for the blockhole, Sehwag wanted to launch that into orbit but he misses it, the ball misses leg stump and beats the keeper as well, Amit covers his face in disappointment
worked towards backward square leg for a couple, Sehwag motors along to 33 off 13

not for a second time though, again it is pitched up, a clean swing of the bat sends it over the bowler's head, not timed as well as he would have liked so it doesn't carry for a six, but it is safe and gets him four
getting a bit of swing there, pitched up and that moved away a hint, even Sehwag is happy to defend
Pietersen is happy looking for the single here as Sehwag is getting the boundaries, this time KP defends towards cover but can't get a run
short of length and just outside off, powerfully slapped towards deep backward point, only a single this time
short from Watson, Sehwag was waiting on the back foot, spots it early and pulls it towards deep midwicket, vacant area that, nearly carries all the way
gets a quick single towards mid-off
the seamers getting a bit of help here, Watson beats KP with a delivery that snaked away, KP flirts with it but misses
shortish ball is helped towards square leg for a single
pushed towards cover by KP
goes for another big hit but can't connect well, edged towards short fine for a single
slammed off the back foot towards wide long-on for four more, Sehwag is on a roll here

another boundary for Sehwag, not in control this time, a length ball is inside-edged for four toward square leg,  brad Hodge  says that would have got Sehwag only a couple at the McG, here it races to the boundary, wasn't where he intended, was looking more towards midwicket
just short of a length, on middle stump, not much wrong with that, just a touch short, Sehwag is on the back foot and slams that towards deep midwicket for four more
floated in towards leg stump, worked towards midwicket for one more
on the pads this time, and another easy putaway for sehwag, clipped off the pads towards fine leg for four more, Sehwag is 8 off 3
short and wide, Sehwag loves it there, as do many batsmen, he hammers that past a diving backward point for four, thats too easy for Viru, especially in the form he is in
short of length once more, KP skips down the track and drives that towards mid-off
back of a length and outside off, defended to the off side
plenty of movement there for Pankaj, seaming away after pitching outside off, Pietersen is left searching for that outside off
shortish ball that KP decides to pull, not timed too well, but he gets it wide of midwicket, hit high on the bat but enough on it to send it to the boundary
Sehwag skips out first ball and thumps the ball towards extra cover, hits it too hard to have time for a single
short of length ball that is punched off the front foot towards long-off
he looks to whip the first ball off the pads, can't beat the fielder

big wicket, Chavan strikes in the middle over, just the start a demoralised Rajasthan wanted, Jayawardene was caught on the crease as he looked to tuck that to the leg side, that looked to be heading for middle stump, the umpire didn't have to think twice, Mahela gone for a duck
off the pads to the left of the keeper
Mahela looks to cut the ball turning in with the arm towards off, cramped and he gets it towards slip
